summary: Frozen third-cycle paired cases spanning distinct product-surface archetypes after the second-cycle negative smoke, without exposing evaluator oracles to workers.

cases.title: Operations workbench
cases.taskPrompt: Improve this incident operations workbench so an on-call engineer can scan severity, ownership, recency, and the next response action quickly. Preserve the existing filtering and selection behavior and use the project's supplied tokens and components.

cases.title: Transaction trust
cases.taskPrompt: Improve this international transfer confirmation so the sender can understand the amount, rate, fees, arrival estimate, recipient, and irreversible consequence before confirming. Preserve calculations and submission behavior.
rubricDimensions: action labels, feedback, errors, empty states, and recovery
inclusion, user agency, and interruption discipline

cases.title: Discovery coordination
cases.taskPrompt: Improve this workspace discovery page so people can coordinate filters, results, saved state, and the selected workspace without losing context. Preserve search, filtering, and selection behavior.

cases.title: Documentation workspace
cases.taskPrompt: Improve this API quickstart so a developer can understand the sequence, switch language, compare explanation with code, and identify the next step without losing reading context. Preserve language switching.

cases.title: Responsive transformation
cases.taskPrompt: Make this scheduling workspace genuinely useful on narrow screens. Preserve the desktop timeline, but transform navigation, date controls, resource context, and appointment details instead of merely shrinking or stacking them.

cases.title: Failure recovery
cases.taskPrompt: Improve the failed invoice-import state so the operator understands what succeeded, what failed, what was preserved, and the safest recovery action. Preserve retry, download, and cancel behavior without exposing internal implementation details.
rubricDimensions: action labels, feedback, errors, empty states, and recovery
plain language, terminology, voice, and contextual tone

cases.title: Product character
cases.taskPrompt: Give this independent audio marketplace a distinctive, credible browsing experience using its supplied editorial assets and tokens. Improve hierarchy, color roles, density, and product character while preserving preview and save controls; avoid generic SaaS card styling.

cases.title: Complete service flow
cases.taskPrompt: Improve this appointment-booking review step across hierarchy, responsive behavior, validation feedback, consent, recovery, and final confirmation. Preserve the existing choices and booking behavior and keep the public-service tone calm and direct.
